notes: This minor release widens the activation of bifrost.python-performance-summaries, now 1.1.0, from an exact CPython 3.13.5 toolchain to cpython >=3.10.0, <3.15.0, the range of the typeshed standard-library pack. Bifrost derives the toolchain from a project's requires-python lower bound, so projects declaring 3.10 through 3.14 now activate the reviewed time.sleep, subprocess.run, pickle.dumps and pickle.loads, sorted and list.sort, buffered read, sqlite3 Cursor.execute and http.client HTTPConnection.request effects that the Python arms of the bifrost.performance loop policies read. Every modeled operation keeps its identity and positional arity across those versions in the pinned Typeshed revision; summaries, IDs, provenance, notice, license and completeness are unchanged. Projects below 3.10 still activate no Python standard-library model. json and re performance effects remain source-only. All other jobs, recipes and the Bifrost 0.14.0 generator are unchanged from 0.6.1; generated schema requirements remain 8 and 17. The C# BCL and System.Web declaration models added to the source catalog since 0.6.1 are not selected by any recipe, so they are source additions, not native additions. Generation, integrity, compatibility and per-run completeness remain separate from behavior qualification. Rules 0.7.0 is needed for normal acquisition to select this pack release.
